language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Changes the language of the app. The project language — the one Kato asks and judges in — is set separately on the practice page.

entryGate.title: Put your name on this workspace.
entryGate.intro: Start immediately without creating an account. Your display name and guest rehearsal history stay in this browser unless you deliberately use the synced account option.
entryGate.nameRequired: Type the name you want on this workspace.
entryGate.syncTitle: Need your projects on another device?
entryGate.syncBody: The account page uses the configured authentication service for optional sync.
entryGate.asideQuote: “Bring the rubric you will actually be judged against.”

landing.lede: No score. No speaking-ability rating. Just your own sentences, mapped to the rubric you will be marked against.
landing.demoQuote: “Unlike generic delivery coaches, Talk-Active starts from the evaluator rubric.”
landing.demoCitation: Exact words from the rehearsal transcript
landing.demoGap: Name the closest alternative and the mechanism it lacks.
landing.demoQuestion: What makes this different from putting the same rubric into a general chat tool?
landing.useCasesTitle: One method, plenty of rooms that decide things.
landing.useCase1Body: Connect your product claims to the scoring rubric before the Q&A.
landing.useCase2Body: Make each selection criterion obvious in the answer you rehearse.
landing.useCase3Body: Find where a method or conclusion still wobbles.
landing.useCase4Body: Any room where a written rubric decides the outcome.
landing.footerTagline: Rubric-grounded rehearsal for answers that need evidence.
landing.loopTitle: Four steps, one piece of evidence.
landing.loopStep1Body: One place for one talk you are preparing.
landing.loopStep2Body: The real one you will be marked against, not a generic example.
landing.loopStep3Body: Type it or say it. Camera and microphone stay off until you turn them on.
landing.loopStep4Body: Your own sentences mapped to each criterion — and what is still missing.

account.title: Practise first. Sync only when it helps.
account.lede: An account is for continuity across devices. It never gates a first rehearsal.
account.guestTitle: Account sync is not configured here.
account.guestBody: Your local workspace remains fully usable. When the deployment has Postgres and an auth secret, this same screen enables account creation and sign-in.
account.passwordNote: Use 10–128 characters. Passwords are handled by Better Auth; Talk-Active does not place them in project or transcript records.
account.importLegacy: Bring in {count, plural, one {# browser project} other {# browser projects}}
account.deleteInstruction: Type {phrase} to remove the account, sessions, projects, and synced transcripts by database cascade. Local browser data is separate.
account.guide1Body: No account is required for a first run.
account.guide2Body: Account records live in the configured Postgres deployment, not inside transcripts.
account.guide3Body: Signing in does not change where configured model providers process criterion-scoped text.
account.boundaryBody: A camera-and-microphone replay is saved only after you opt in. Durable replay requires a signed-in owner and private storage; deleting it keeps the text feedback. Local work is separate.
account.statusCreated: Account created. This browser can now sync work when persistence is enabled.
account.statusRequestFailed: The account request could not be completed.
account.statusSignedOut: Signed out. Local guest mode remains available.
account.statusExported: Local browser data exported. Nothing was deleted.
account.statusImported: {projects} projects and {sessions} session summaries imported. The original browser data is still here.
account.statusImportFailed: The local workspace could not be imported.
account.statusDeleted: Synced account data was permanently deleted. Local browser data was left untouched.
account.statusDeleteFailed: The account data could not be deleted.

workspaceFrame.profileAnonymous: Put your name on this workspace

progressCharts.trendEmpty: Save a practice session to begin the evidence trend.

fillers.label: Filler frequency
fillers.measured: {count} configured filler events found in the transcript.

pauseRatio.label: Pause ratio
pauseRatio.absent: Audio pause observations were not supplied.

pitchVariation.label: Pitch variation
pitchVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean pitch for voiced samples.
pitchVariation.absent: At least five voiced pitch samples are required.

energyVariation.label: Energy variation
energyVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean RMS energy for non-silent samples.
energyVariation.absent: At least five non-silent energy samples are required.

trackingCoverage.label: Tracking coverage
trackingCoverage.measured: {tracked} of {sampled} sampled frames contained usable landmarks.

framingCoverage.label: Framing coverage
framingCoverage.measured: {framed} of {tracked} tracked frames met the mode framing rule. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.
framingCoverage.absent: Usable landmarks are required before framing can be measured. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.

movementActivity.label: Movement activity
movementActivity.measured: {active} tracked frames crossed the calibrated movement threshold.
movementActivity.absent: Usable landmarks are required before movement can be measured.

micQuality.silentBody: No signal at all. Check whether it is muted, or whether another device is selected.
micQuality.clippingTitle: This microphone is too loud and distorting
micQuality.clippingBody: The level is pinned, so words run together. Move back a little or turn the device gain down.
micQuality.noisyFloorBody: Something is audible between every phrase — usually a mic being held, vibrating, or resting on a desk. The recognizer has no silence to break sentences on. Try a stable surface, or the laptop microphone.
micQuality.tooQuietTitle: This is too faint to recognise
micQuality.tooQuietBody: There is sound, but very little of it. Move closer or turn the device gain up.
micQuality.boundary: This reads levels from our recording stream, not from the recognizer — echo and room reverb are not detected here.
micQuality.typedFallback: You can always type the transcript instead.
micQuality.guessedTitle: Some of this transcript was guessed
micQuality.guessedBody: The recognizer was unsure about {count, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}}. Check and correct them before reviewing — a misheard passage gets quoted back as your own words.

progressView.title: Practice history
progressView.deliveryAndEvidenceSaved: Delivery observations and rubric evidence saved
progressView.emptyProject: No attempts saved to this project yet.
progressView.emptyProjectOrSummaries: No attempts or browser summaries have been saved to this project yet.
progressView.emptyGuest: No sessions saved in the production guest workspace yet.
progressView.needTwoAttempts: Save two reviewed attempts with criterion evidence to compare their exact quotes and gaps.
progressView.needAnotherAttempt: Complete another reviewed attempt before Talk-Active calls any gap recurring.
progressView.recurringBoundary: A criterion appears here only after at least two attempts left some required evidence implicit. Coverage describes this saved transcript history—not your ability.
progressView.movementBoundary: Movement describes explicit coverage in these two attempts—not confidence or ability.
progressView.steadyCoverage: Explicit coverage held steady on every criterion between these two attempts.
progressView.historicalOnly: Historical summary only. That session did not retain the original criterion quote or missing-cue list.
progressView.localBoundary: Local recurring gaps and comparisons use only criterion evidence retained in this browser. Older summaries stay labelled when their original quote or missing-cue list was never retained.
progressView.syncedBoundary: Recurring gaps and exact attempt comparisons use synced verdict rows only, with zero model calls. Project-scoped browser summaries appear only in the session count, coverage trend, and archive; separate interview answers remain page-local.
progressView.criterionAbsent: This criterion was not present in this rubric.
progressView.changedLastTwo: What changed between the last two reviewed attempts
progressView.trackExplicit: Track explicit evidence and recurring weak claims without inventing a universal speaking score.

savedReview.checkingAccess: Checking access to this private review.
savedReview.couldNotOpen: This review could not be opened.
savedReview.unreadable: The server did not return a readable attempt review.
savedReview.startWithProof: Start with the proof. Fix one gap.
savedReview.keepDefensible: Keep the cited claims defensible and rehearse the hardest judge follow-up.
savedReview.everyCriterionAndState: Every rubric criterion and its evidence state
savedReview.exactSpanRetained: Exact transcript span retained with this verdict
savedReview.noSpanSupports: No transcript span supports this verdict.
savedReview.makeExplicitNext: Make this evidence explicit in the next rehearsal.
savedReview.noVerdicts: No rubric verdicts were retained for this attempt.
savedReview.coverageBoundary: This is evidence coverage in one transcript—not confidence, intelligence, or speaking ability.
savedReview.evidenceFirst: The exact rubric evidence comes first. Delivery observations remain supporting context and never change a criterion verdict.
savedReview.evidenceButNoDelivery: This attempt has rubric evidence but no saved delivery observation.
savedReview.savedFormatBoundary: This saved format retains inspectable counts, capture coverage, and timestamped cues. It does not retain the component bands needed to defend an aggregate delivery reading, so no vocal, visual, or overall score is shown. Camera, microphone, framing, and tracking quality affect what could be measured.
savedReview.rubricVoiceCamera: Rubric, voice, and camera on one clock
savedReview.timelineBoundary: The saved attempt retains clock positions for delivery cues. It does not retain word-level timing, so rubric citations stay visible above but are not given an invented timestamp here.
savedReview.noTimestampedRetained: No timestamped delivery cue was retained for this attempt.
savedReview.replayPreparing: The private replay is still being prepared. The saved evidence is already available.
savedReview.replayNotSaved: No replay was saved. The transcript, rubric evidence, and delivery observations remain available.
savedReview.replayStoreFailed: The replay could not be stored. The transcript, rubric evidence, and delivery observations were kept.
savedReview.observationsWithoutReplay: The observations remain readable without a replay. Timeline marks become playable only when the private video is ready.
savedReview.deleteOnlyVideo: Delete only the video? The transcript, delivery observations, and rubric evidence will remain.
savedReview.deleteFailed: The recording could not be deleted.
savedReview.deleted: The replay was deleted. Delivery observations, transcript, and rubric evidence were kept.
savedReview.cannotPlay: Your browser cannot play this saved rehearsal video.
savedReview.playFromBefore: Play the replay from two seconds before this.
savedReview.replayUnavailableCue: The replay is not available, so this cue cannot be played.

interviewSession.heading: Answer one rubric question at a time.
interviewSession.answerPlaceholder: Start with a direct answer, then give the evidence and why it matters…
interviewSession.waitPlaceholder: Begin this answer after Kato finishes speaking…
interviewSession.startOrType: Start optional capture below, or type without media.
interviewSession.captureRequired: Continuous capture must start before the first answer
interviewSession.captureBoundary: Camera and an optional replay share one timeline. Dictation and acoustic observations run only inside answer windows, never while Kato narrates.
interviewSession.pausedBoundary: Camera and the optional replay remain active between questions. Answer text and voice observations are paused while Kato speaks.
interviewSession.modelBoundary: No model request runs between questions. Final submit sends each answer only with its paired rubric criterion; Kato's question text is excluded. Separated turn transcripts and an optional replay remain page-local in this experimental flow; saved progress keeps the aggregate rubric summary.
interviewSession.answerNotSaved: This answer could not be saved.
interviewSession.pauseFirst: Pause the current answer before asking Kato to read the question.
interviewSession.narrationUnavailable: Audio narration is unavailable here; the complete question remains visible.
interviewSession.narrationStopped: Question narration stopped unexpectedly. The complete question remains visible as text.
interviewSession.semanticUnavailable: Semantic evidence mapping is unavailable, so the final batch will use labelled deterministic cue matching.
interviewSession.reviewFailed: The final interview review could not be completed.
interviewSession.reviewIncomplete: The final interview review did not map every answer back to its rubric criterion.
interviewSession.noCriterionEvidence: The deterministic interview review returned no criterion evidence.

multimodalReview.rubricVoiceCamera: Rubric, voice, and camera on one clock
multimodalReview.readAsText: Read the timeline and cited transcript as text
multimodalReview.markedTextBoundary: Marked text is copied from the transcript as text nodes; nothing is rewritten or injected as markup.
multimodalReview.noRubricTimeline: No rubric timeline was supplied for this attempt.
multimodalReview.noEvidenceCited: No evidence was cited for this criterion.
multimodalReview.noClockPosition: No citation was assigned a clock position; none is invented.
multimodalReview.noCandidateCrossed: No timestamped voice or camera candidate crossed the prototype thresholds.
multimodalReview.noTimingAvailable: No transcript or acoustic timing was available to read.
multimodalReview.evidenceStaysAbove: Rubric evidence and the next judge question stay above this panel. The observations here never change those verdicts.
multimodalReview.fullReadings: Full readings, weighting, limitations, and raw counts
multimodalReview.nothingMeasurable: Nothing measurable was observed in this attempt
multimodalReview.shadedZone: The shaded zone is the configured practice band; the mark is this attempt. A threshold comparison, not a pass or a fail.
multimodalReview.oneAttemptBoundary: This number describes one rehearsal attempt, not your ability.
multimodalReview.landmarkBoundary: Camera-landmark observation. Review the surrounding context before interpreting it.
multimodalReview.cameraUnavailable: Camera observations were unavailable for this attempt.
multimodalReview.cameraNotPart: The camera was not part of this attempt.
multimodalReview.noReplayKept: No camera-and-microphone replay was kept. The rubric evidence and timestamped observations above remain usable.
multimodalReview.timelineControls: Timeline controls start two seconds before an observation so you can judge its context yourself.
multimodalReview.playFromBefore: Play from two seconds before this.
multimodalReview.inspectMoments: Inspect the moments that may need another look.
multimodalReview.addMissingClaim: Add the missing claim without repeating the whole take.
multimodalReview.answerWindowsOnClock: {count} use their answer windows on the interview clock; review the whole window because no word-level time is invented.
multimodalReview.coarseTiming: {count} could be placed on the clock from coarse dictation timing; use it to find the moment, not to sync a word.

rubricEditor.title: Modify rubric
rubricEditor.nothingSavedYet: Nothing is saved yet. Confirm the wording of every row, then save.
rubricEditor.notConfirmed: This project rubric has not been confirmed yet. Review every row before saving it.
rubricEditor.noRubricSaved: No rubric is saved to this project yet. The starter rows below remain unsaved until you confirm them.
rubricEditor.invalidRestored: The saved local rubric was invalid, so the finals starter rubric was restored.
rubricEditor.keepOne: Keep at least one named criterion. Add a description or evidence cues whenever the source provides them.
rubricEditor.uniqueRows: Each criterion needs a unique row and no more than 40 concise evidence phrases.
rubricEditor.beginFamiliar: Begin from a familiar evaluation context
rubricEditor.startingPoints: These are editable starting points, not official scoring rubrics. Use the evaluator’s published matrix whenever one exists.
rubricEditor.pasteHint: Paste published evaluator criteria. Talk-Active structures the source, but you confirm every row before it is saved.
rubricEditor.structureFailed: Rubric source could not be structured
rubricEditor.structureFailedBody: The rubric source could not be structured.
rubricEditor.checkingOwner: Checking which project owns this rubric…
rubricEditor.staysWithProject: The URL, rubric, practice, and saved evidence stay with this project.
rubricEditor.discardChanges: Discard the unsaved rubric changes and switch projects?
rubricEditor.projectUnavailable: That synced project is not available in this session. Your local rubric is shown instead.
rubricEditor.projectLoadFailed: The selected project could not be loaded.
rubricEditor.projectSaveFailed: The selected project rubric could not be saved.
rubricEditor.wrongProject: The server returned a different project. Nothing from it was shown.
rubricEditor.wrongProjectSaved: The server saved a different project rubric. Nothing from it was shown.
rubricEditor.starterLoadedToast: {name} starter loaded. Replace any cue that does not match your evaluator, then confirm with Save rubric.

workspace.staysTogether: The project, rubric, language, practice, and saved progress stay together.
workspace.projectUnavailable: That synced project is not available in this session. Your local workspace is shown instead.
workspace.verifyFailed: The saved project could not be verified. Check your connection and try again.
workspace.wrongProject: The server returned a different project. Nothing from it was shown.
workspace.traceToRubric: Trace it to the active rubric.
workspace.makeHarder: Make your next answer harder to challenge.
workspace.startWithAttempt: Start with one complete attempt against your active rubric.
workspace.openProgressHint: Open Progress for the synced evidence history, or rehearse again against this project’s rubric and language.
workspace.noRehearsals: No rehearsals saved yet. Complete one practice attempt and its traceable evidence will appear here.
workspace.saveOneAttempt: Save one reviewed attempt to make this dashboard follow your real rubric evidence.
workspace.coverageBoundary: Coverage counts explicit rubric evidence in a transcript. It is not a score for you.
workspace.oneTranscriptBoundary: That result describes one saved transcript, not confidence or speaking ability. Rehearse again to see whether the evidence holds.
workspace.pairNotTrend: Two saved attempts is a pair, not yet a trend. Save one more to see a direction.
workspace.recordedInLatest: Recorded in the latest saved attempt
workspace.everySupported: Every criterion is supported. Raise the bar?
workspace.completeCoverage: Your latest saved attempt recorded complete rubric evidence coverage.
workspace.syncedPlusBrowser: Synced attempts plus unmatched browser-only summaries
workspace.validRetained: Valid attempts retained in this browser

studio.title: Multimodal rehearsal
studio.subtitle: Camera landmarks + acoustic observations + your active rubric, assembled into one review.
studio.chooseObserve: Choose what this rehearsal may observe
studio.enableThenStart: Enable only the capture permissions you want, then start. Manual transcript entry remains available.
studio.enableOne: Enable one capture permission, or use the manual transcript below.
studio.localLandmarks: Local landmarks only; frames and landmarks are discarded after capture.
studio.localPauses: Local pauses, pitch and energy; this choice does not record raw audio.
studio.dictationUnavailable: Unavailable here. Type or paste the transcript instead.
studio.keptInPage: Kept only in this page for review or download.
studio.uploadsPrivately: Uploads privately for this signed-in attempt; deleting it keeps feedback.
studio.calibrating: Calibrating for 3 seconds. Face the camera in a neutral starting position.
studio.captureContinues: Capture continues until the interview ends
studio.interviewComplete: Interview capture complete. Delivery observations stay hidden until the interview ends.
studio.captured: Rehearsal captured. Review the three evidence layers below.
studio.timeRanOut: Time ran out and capture stopped itself, exactly as an evaluator would. Review the three evidence layers below.
studio.answerActive: Answer capture is active. Camera tracking and an optional replay continue across the whole session.
studio.sessionPaused: Session is running. Answer dictation and acoustic observations are paused until the first answer begins.
studio.stillRunning: Session is still running. Answer dictation and acoustic observations are paused; camera tracking and an optional replay continue.
studio.noTranscript: No transcript was captured. You can type one and review again.
studio.dictationUnsupported: Live browser dictation is unavailable here. The observations you selected are running; type the transcript afterward.
studio.mediaUnavailable: Camera and microphone capture are unavailable in this browser. Manual transcript review still works.
studio.startFailed: The multimodal rehearsal could not start.
studio.waitTransition: Wait for the current capture transition to finish.
studio.waitTransitionStop: Wait for the current capture transition to finish before stopping.
studio.localBoundary: Analysis runs on this device. A replay is created only when you explicitly ask for one above.
studio.interviewBoundary: Analysis runs on this device. This interview does not retain a camera or microphone replay.
studio.consentBoundary: Camera and voice cues run locally and are discarded. Live transcript may use your browser vendor. Replay is a separate camera + microphone recording and stays off unless enabled.
studio.dictationStatus: Dictation: {state}. Browser dictation may use the browser vendor's speech service.

practice.confirmTheProjectAndEvaluator: Confirm the project and evaluator rubric. Both stay attached to this session.
practice.usedForKatoAposS: Used for Kato's questions, narration, and live browser transcript.
practice.projectLanguageSyncedQuestionsNarration: Project language synced. Questions, narration, and live transcript now use it.
practice.deliverOneContinuousPitchThen: Deliver one continuous pitch, then review it.
practice.fiveFixedRubricQuestionsThen: Five fixed rubric questions, then one final answer-local review.
practice.captureStopsItselfAtThe: Capture stops itself at the bell. 0 removes the limit.
practice.setATimeLimitTo: Set a time limit to see what an evaluator stopping on time would miss.
practice.theReviewMarksWhichOf: The review marks which of these you reached, and when.
practice.optionalAttachUpToThree: Optional: attach up to three UTF-8 text, Markdown, or JSON files, 40 KB each. Files stay in private project storage.
practice.groundTheJudgeQuestionIn: Ground the judge question in your material
practice.theSourceDocumentCouldNot: The source document could not be attached.
practice.theSourceDocumentCouldNot2: The source document could not be removed.
practice.typeOrPasteTheAttempt: Type or paste the attempt below, then review it. No camera or microphone is involved.
practice.tickWhatThisRehearsalMay: Tick what this rehearsal may observe. Every signal is off until you choose it, and nothing is requested before Start.
practice.cameraVoiceLiveTranscriptAnd: Camera, voice, live transcript, and replay stay independently optional.
practice.setByCaptureEditIt: Set by capture. Edit it when you typed the transcript.
practice.rehearseOneAttemptAtA: Rehearse one attempt at a time.
practice.completeTheAttemptNaturallyThe: Complete the attempt naturally. The review isolates only the next weakness worth fixing.
practice.oneClaimNeedsYourAttention: One claim needs your attention before the judges find it.
practice.yourAnswerEvidenceMappedAcross: Your answer evidence, mapped across the whole rubric.
practice.evidenceMappedByDeterministicCue: Evidence mapped by deterministic cue matching on this device.
practice.everyRubricCriterionAndWhether: Every rubric criterion and whether this attempt cites a transcript span for it
practice.breakThisDownCriterionBy: Break this down criterion by criterion
practice.breakThisDownAnswerBy: Break this down answer by answer
practice.everyCriterionGetsItsOwn: Every criterion gets its own reading: what you asserted for it, which of those assertions you backed with your own words, and a stronger form built only from what you already said.
practice.everyAnswerGetsItsOwn: Every answer gets its own reading: what you asserted for its criterion, which of those assertions you backed with your own words, and a stronger form built only from what you already said. Each answer is read on its own, so Kato’s wording never counts as your evidence.
practice.claimCoachingIsUnavailableRight: Claim coaching is unavailable right now. The rubric verdicts above are unaffected.
practice.coachingForThisAnswerWas: Coaching for this answer was unavailable. Its verdict above is unaffected.
practice.yourYesOrNoOn: Your Yes or No on a criterion is recorded once as your own evaluation label, and cannot be changed afterwards.
practice.theSemanticReviewFoundNo: The semantic review found no exact passage that supplies this criterion's required evidence.
practice.nothingInThisAttemptMatched: Nothing in this attempt matched the declared cues for this criterion.
practice.oneQuoteIsDoingMore: One quote is doing more than one job.
practice.nothingInThisAttemptBacks: Nothing in this attempt backs it.
practice.thisAttemptAssertsNothingAbout: This attempt asserts nothing about this criterion — there is no claim to back or challenge yet.
practice.aStrongerFormOfThis: A stronger form of this answer
practice.eachBlankIsDataThis: Each blank is data this attempt never stated. Fill it with a number you have — or say the measurement has not been done, which is also an answer.
practice.rearrangedFromYourOwnWords: Rearranged from your own words only. A number absent from your transcript is rejected before this is shown.
practice.thisCheckUsesOnlyThe: This check uses only the answer above, never the original pitch.
practice.answerDirectlyNameTheMechanism: Answer directly. Name the mechanism, comparison, or proof the rubric expects.
practice.sayItInYourOwn: Say it in your own words.
practice.checkedByDeterministicCueMatching: Checked by deterministic cue matching because semantic defense evaluation is not configured.
practice.hostedDefenseEvaluationWasUnavailable: Hosted defense evaluation was unavailable. This visible deterministic fallback was not synced.
practice.mappedSemanticallyAgainstThisAnswer: Mapped semantically against this answer, then grounded to the exact cited span.
practice.sessionHistoryStaysInThis: Session history stays in this browser
practice.reviewAnAttemptBeforeEntering: Review an attempt before entering the judge room.
practice.everyVerdictBelowUsedOnly: Every verdict below used only its paired answer. Kato's wording was excluded from evidence.
practice.oneFinalBatchProducedThese: One final batch produced these answer-local verdicts. Question text is shown for context but was never sent as answer evidence.
practice.oneContinuousInterviewCaptureIs: One continuous interview capture is attached to this page-local review.
practice.noCameraOrMicrophoneCapture: No camera or microphone capture was attached to this interview.
practice.wordsThatInviteTheNext: Words that invite the next question
practice.countedByExactWordMatching: Counted by exact word matching in this transcript, on this device. Ordinary phrasing can be perfectly fine — the point is knowing which follow-up each word invites before an evaluator asks it.
practice.wordPatternCountsFromThis: Word-pattern counts from this transcript, and not a measure of speaking ability. This does not change the rubric evidence above.
practice.captureOnlyTheMissingPassage: Capture only the missing passage. It will be labelled as an addition and re-judge this criterion alone.
practice.sayOrTypeOnlyThe: Say or type only the passage that proves this criterion. It is appended to the attempt and labelled as an addition — the original take is never rewritten — and only this criterion is judged again.
practice.nameTheNumberMethodOr: Name the number, method, or mechanism this criterion asks for.
practice.typeTheAdditionBelowOr: Type the addition below, or switch to
practice.theAdditionTranscriptIsReady: The addition transcript is ready. Review it, then append and re-judge this criterion.
practice.thatCriterionIsNoLonger: That criterion is no longer part of this review.
practice.savedAsAHumanConfirmed: Saved as a human-confirmed evaluation label. No model call was made.
practice.savedInThisBrowserThis: Saved in this browser. This criterion was re-checked once with the rejected sentence excluded.
practice.savedInThisBrowserA: Saved in this browser. A one-time semantic re-judge used different grounded evidence and refreshed the question.
practice.savedInThisBrowserThe: Saved in this browser. The hosted re-judge was unavailable, so one visible deterministic fallback ran locally.
practice.savedInThisBrowserThe2: Saved in this browser. The one-time re-judge used mixed semantic and deterministic units, shown in provenance.
practice.savedThisCriterionWasRe: Saved. This criterion was re-judged once without the rejected evidence.
practice.savedNoDifferentGroundedEvidence: Saved. No different grounded evidence was found, so this criterion is now unsupported.
practice.savedWithSemanticEvidenceMapping: Saved with semantic evidence mapping. The cited text comes only from this answer.
practice.savedWithALabelledDeterministic: Saved with a labelled deterministic fallback. Only this answer was evaluated.
practice.thisEvaluationLabelCouldNot: This evaluation label could not be saved.
practice.aPersistedVerdictDidNot: A persisted verdict did not map to its confirmed criterion.
practice.thePersistedReviewContainedNo: The persisted review contained no criteria.
practice.theDeterministicReviewReturnedNo: The deterministic review returned no weakest criterion.
practice.theAttemptCouldNotBe: The attempt could not be analysed.
practice.theDefenseCouldNotBe: The defense could not be evaluated.
practice.theDefenseCouldNotBe2: The defense could not be synced.
practice.semanticReviewIsOffSo: Semantic review is off, so this attempt is checked on-device. Raw audio is never saved.
practice.semanticReviewSendsThisTranscript: Semantic review sends this transcript and the typed rubric criteria to the configured model provider. Grounded review results may be cached for up to 24 hours. Raw audio is never saved.
practice.whenSemanticQuestionGenerationIs: When semantic question generation is configured, the weakest criterion and attached text are processed by the configured model provider. Otherwise, Talk-Active selects an exact source sentence deterministically.
practice.attemptsAndPrivateSourceFiles: Attempts and private source files are saved to the configured project services. Raw audio is never saved.
practice.derivedSensorSummariesAreAvailable: Derived sensor summaries are available for this review only.
practice.derivedFromOnDeviceCamera: Derived from on-device camera landmarks; review the surrounding replay before interpreting it.
practice.timestampedDeliveryObservationsWereSaved: Timestamped delivery observations were saved with this attempt. No replay was recorded.
practice.timestampedObservationsWereSavedThis: Timestamped observations were saved. This replay stays in this page only; download it before leaving.
practice.privateReplaySavedItIs: Private replay saved. It is now available from attempt history and can be deleted without deleting feedback.
practice.uploadingThePrivateReplayKeep: Uploading the private replay… Keep this review open until it finishes.
practice.theTranscriptChangedSoThe: The transcript changed, so the prior sensor summary was detached. Capture again to include fresh observations.
practice.projectSyncIsActiveOn: Project sync is active on this deployment
practice.thisProjectHasNoConfirmed: This project has no confirmed rubric yet. Confirm its rubric before starting a rehearsal.
practice.confirmThisProjectSRubric: Confirm this project’s rubric before saving an attempt to it.
practice.thisSignedInProjectAlready: This signed-in project already has a confirmed rubric. Its saved criteria were restored; browser-only rubric edits do not replace a synced project rubric.
practice.thatSelectedProjectCouldNot: That selected project could not be opened. Choose another project; no saved project data was changed.
practice.yourSavedProjectCouldNot: Your saved project could not be restored just now, so this attempt uses the rubric stored in this browser. Nothing saved on the server has been changed.
